issue.title: Initialize io.vertx.ext.auth.impl.jose.JWT at runtime
issue.body:
It contains a Random field so we can't initialize it at static init.

Fixes #17657

body:
> @Sgitario #17660 should fix it

Thanks a lot! You were so fast, brilliant! :D

Hi @Sgitario Why is it a regression from the Quarkus's point of view ? Indeed, the library was indirectly included before `1.13.x.Final` by `quarkus-oidc` but it has not been an independent Quarkus feature.

> Hi @Sgitario Why is it a regression from the Quarkus's point of view ? Indeed, the library was indirectly included before `1.13.x.Final` by `quarkus-oidc` but it has not been an independent Quarkus feature.

Fair point. I put regression because it started failing when using a newer version of GraalVM, so it's not a regression of quarkus's point of view. I've already updated the title.
